title: Jimmy Barnes 'For The Working Class Man' 40th Anniversary Australian Tour: Presale, dates, venues, and more explored - NewsBreak
text: On July 31, 2025, Jimmy Barnes announced his upcoming tour, titled ‘Working Class Man,’ to celebrate forty years of his eponymous album. In November 2025, Working Class Man will complete its four decades of release. In his latest Instagram post, Jimmy Barnes said: ​ He went on to mention the names of special guests who will join these celebrations. Icehouse, Ian Moss and Kate Ceberano will be the guests for Jimmy’s tour. ​ Members of Barnes' mailing list will receive exclusive access to presale tickets on Wednesday, August 6, 2025, at 12 PM local time. Fans can visit www.jimmybarnes.com, for more information and to join mailing list. The tickets for Jimmy Barnes tour will go on sale to the general public on Thursday, August 7, 2025, at 2 PM local time. Jimmy Barnes anniversary tour is set to kickoff on November 22 and it will conclude on February 7, 2025. The anniversary reissue of ‘The Working Class Man’ is coming via Mushroom. As stated by Jimmy, the album has been remastered and will be released as a double LP on flame-coloured, hand-poured vinyl. Here’s a complete rundown of dates and venues of Jimmy Barnes' Working Class Man 40th Anniversary Tour: Jimmy also revealed a limited-edition boxset of colorful singles comprising Ride The Night Away, Working Class Man, I'd Die To Be With You Tonight, and a new fourth single with a stripped-down rendition of Working Class Man . In addition, the artist intends to offer CDs and cassettes to his followers and collectors.
